mergeContract.rule: Compare dates per FIELD, not per quest. Keep whichever value is newer.
mergeContract.undated: dating:"none" means the source cannot say when the value was last true. Never let an undated value overwrite a dated one, in either direction.
mergeContract.quickCheck: Each quest carries a top-level `asOf`, the newest of its field dates. If yours is newer than that, you can skip the whole record.
